summary: Inventoried 6 e2e hop owners all defaulting to nil/discard no-op (no production sink installed; setters test-only). Designed bounded metadata-only RingSink (e2e.Sink, fixed-cap ring, newest-wins overflow with dropped counter, O(1) non-blocking Record, no goroutine/busy-loop, thread-safe) + pull-based exporter (Snapshot/promexport bounded-cardinality, no id/pseudonym labels). Shared single recorder injected at boot across backend+daemon seams (SetIngressRecorder, TaskService.Obs, hub.SetDeliveryRecorder, daemon.cliObs, gateway executor SetRecorder), gated OFF by default flag; W1-serial anchors. Metadata-only/fail-closed enforced upstream by Recorder.Emit. Priority-2/DEFERRED behind P0.
